key: OLD MAN: Oh, you're not with Team Meteor, are you?
en: OLD MAN: Oh, you're not with Team Meteor, are you?
ja: おじいさん: おお、あんた、メテオ団の者じゃないよな?

key: OLD WOMAN: Have you come to save us?
en: OLD WOMAN: Have you come to save us?
ja: おばあさん: わたしたちを助けに来てくれたの?

key: OLD MAN: We run the Day Care in the Obsidia Ward.
en: OLD MAN: We run the Day Care in the Obsidia Ward.
ja: おじいさん: わしらはオブシディアワードで預かり屋をやっとるんじゃ。

key: Team Meteor abducted us so we could no longer raise the Pokémon of other Trainers.
en: Team Meteor abducted us so we could no longer raise the Pokémon of other Trainers.
ja: メテオ団に連れ去られて、他のトレーナーのポケモンを育てられなくなってしまったんじゃよ。

key: DAY-CARE LADY: They said they were going to impersonate us and start stealing Trainers' Pokémon instead!
en: DAY-CARE LADY: They said they were going to impersonate us and start stealing Trainers' Pokémon instead!
ja: 預かり屋のおばあさん: わたしたちに成りすまして、トレーナーたちのポケモンを盗むつもりだって言ってたわ!

key: DAY-CARE MAN: We overheard one of the assailants talking about storing the stolen Pokémon in a different warehouse.
en: DAY-CARE MAN: We overheard one of the assailants talking about storing the stolen Pokémon in a different warehouse.
ja: 預かり屋のおじいさん: 犯人の一人が、盗んだポケモンを別の倉庫に保管するって話してるのを聞いたんじゃ。

key: I hope they get returned to their owners all right.
en: I hope they get returned to their owners all right.
ja: 無事に飼い主のもとへ返ってくれるといいんじゃが。

key: DAY-CARE LADY: If the Meteors are gone, we should get back to our house and restore our business's reputation.
en: DAY-CARE LADY: If the Meteors are gone, we should get back to our house and restore our business's reputation.
ja: 預かり屋のおばあさん: メテオ団がいなくなったなら、家に戻ってお店の評判を取り戻さないとね。

key: Thank you so, so much, young Trainer. Please drop by any time.
en: Thank you so, so much, young Trainer. Please drop by any time.
ja: 本当に、本当にありがとう、若いトレーナーさん。いつでも寄っていってちょうだいね。
